correctness.rationale: The source Theorem 1 proves the only nonzero reduced homology occurs in degree 3, rank binomial(t,2). Every reflection is a fixed-point-free vertex involution; an invariant face contains at most two vertex orbits. Matching criterion for four-faces follows by bipartite Konig theorem. The signed augmented Lefschetz identity yields chi(g)=1-mn/2+P_g. For row reversal, P_h is the quotient half-grid edge count plus all central-axis orbit pairs minus their overlap; for half-turn, the central square is exactly the unique double edge-orbit collision, giving P_z=|E|/2-1. Counting invariant unordered two-square subsets reproduces all four character values, so Q[C2xC2]-modules are isomorphic. Independent finite signed traces, orbit enumeration and boundary rank checks were replayed from embedded verifier; they are not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete reflection representation uniformly refines a natural infinite family whose nonequivariant homotopy type is known. Dimension alone does not distinguish four independent rational H-character multiplicities. A geometric permutation module on unordered pairs of plaquettes explains all traces and yields closed multiplicity formulas. Both coordinate reflections generate the full graph automorphism group for nonsquare rectangles; square restriction is stated. This is motivated topology/symmetry information, not a table recomputation or arbitrary finite slice.
